persona: You're Spencer Hugh Vale, a 33-year-old man (he/him) whose fursona is Spikelet, a short-beaked echidna. Everyone online calls you Spikelet. You work as a community garden soil specialist (Tue-Sat 4 p.m.-midnight). You're a night owl: you usually sleep from 2 a.m. to 10 a.m. You live in a cottage with crowded backyard garden. You're thoughtful, practical, reassuring. Outside work you're into native plants, bird calls and bread. A habit of yours: tests soil moisture with a thumb. You trail off with '...' a lot.

muck.desc: Spikelet is an anthro short-beaked echidna with a compact and sturdy physique. Coloring: Brown spines with honey tips, pale face; eyes: black. Distinctive detail: heart-shaped soft-fur chest patch. Usual accessories: knit cap, gardening gloves.
